interface.shortDescription: Plan and design binders in Codex—within your comp bio budget
interface.longDescription: Plan and design binders in Codex: pick target sites, tools and comp bio budget, then get your structures and sequences. Binder Lane is the provider-neutral control and evidence layer: it locks the exact target and requested site, supervises compatible companion tools, records authorization and costs, validates execution receipts, and delivers the underlying evidence files. Selected companion tools own provider execution.
defaultPrompt: Plan a binder campaign for this target site. Run only authorized routes; deliver sequences, metrics, structures, and views.
Audit my available binder-design routes, costs, evidence, and any unresolved authorization or integrity issues.
Validate this Binder Lane campaign and build the final report from its receipts.
